name: agent-personality
description: Design personality-driven agents, analyze team composition, and run multi-agent design meetings for Claude Code. Includes agent-personality (builds capability foundations, conducts personality interviews, assembles prompts with four-zone architecture), team-composition (analyzes teams for orientation balance, coverage gaps, overlaps, and attrition patterns), and design-meeting (spawns domain-focused agent teams for adversarial review of specs, designs, and architecture).
